_meta.name: Duscaff Scafflok Plus (steel, 130 cm)
_meta.family: Cuplock 1.25-1.30 m, bays 1.8 / 2.5 m (Cuplok type, node 0.50 m)
_meta.note: Cuplock-type system from the Duscaff brochure: cups every 0.5 m, 2.5 m basic bay and 1.8 m make-up bay, 1.3 m horizontal as transom with a five-board platform of BSI timber boards 38 x 225. The brochure has no diagonals and no weights for jacks, steel planks or couplers. 'verified' = false everywhere.
sources: 736172830-DUSCAFF-SCAFFLOK-PLUS-BROCHURE.pdf p.7 (verticals, horizontals; 'normal horizontals also act as guardrails'), p.8 (span supports: 1.3 m = five-board platform), p.10 (BASE-EXT jack, adjustment up to 0.5 m)

736172830-DUSCAFF-SCAFFLOK-PLUS-BROCHURE.pdf p.11 (BSI timber scaffold board 38 x 225, 3.84 kg/m, 1.2 m span), p.13 (steel planks 38 x 225, no weights), p.15 (EN 39 tube 48.3 x 3.2, 3.56 kg/m), p.16 (couplers, no weights)
approvals: Brochure: products allow compliance with OSHA, BS EN 12810-1/-2, BS EN 12811-1 (no approval number for SCAFFLOK PLUS)
changes: NO DIAGONALS in the brochure: vertical_brace is empty and the engine estimates every brace as hypot(bay, 2.0 m) x 3.56 kg/m (Duscaff EN 39 tube 48.3 x 3.2, p.15; swivel ends not included) - estimated.

Decks = BSI timber boards 38 x 225 at 3.84 kg/m (p.11) x bay length, 5 per bay on the 1.3 m horizontal (p.8: 'standard five-board platform'). Board length = bay length is an assumption (boards may overhang or be lapped). The galvanized steel planks (p.13) have no weights and are not offered as a grade.

BSI boards span only 1.2 m (p.11): a 1.8 m bay needs 1 and a 2.5 m bay 2 intermediate span supports SS-SP-SS-130 (6.2 kg, p.8) per deck level. The engine has no slot for them, so they are NOT in the bill of materials (about 6-12 kg per bay and deck level).
Transom = 1.3 m horizontal SS-SP-H-130 (4.8 kg, p.7) at every standard and level; width 1300 + 48.3 = 1348 mm.
Guard rails = horizontals (p.7). Toeboards = the same timber board on edge, 3.84 kg/m x bay length; end toeboard 1.3 m board; end guard rail = 2 x SS-SP-H-130.

BASE-EXT jack: adjustment up to 0.5 m (p.10) used as ext_max_mm; length (0.7 m) and mass (4.5 kg) are estimated (no data in the brochure). The mass is from the source, so the jack line is not flagged as estimated.
Couplers have no weights (p.16): drop-forged double coupler DF-DBL-01 at 1.0 kg - estimated. Tie = 1 m tube T3-39-10-G (3.56 kg, p.15). Eyebolt 0.2 kg estimated (Plettac value).
Short bay 1.3 m (horizontal SS-SP-H-130, board by kg/m) for fitting and square corners.
No access deck with hatch: no access decks are placed.

rules_verified.note: Duscaff gives no ties, bracing frequency or wall gap: placeholders. Jack travel 0.5 m from the brochure (p.10). brace_est_mass_per_m = 3.56 (Duscaff EN 39 tube 48.3 x 3.2, p.15), because the brochure has no braces. For comparison only (other manufacturer): the SGB Cuplok user guide (339768111, p.2-3, 6-15) asks for a tie at every standard, vertically every 8 m (2 m lifts, pattern A) down to 4.5 m, and one braced bay in every 8 bays (20 m). Not applied here because it is not this manufacturer's document.
